summary: Richard Marcinko ran CIA-backed Phoenix raids in Vietnam, founded SEAL Team Six in 1980, was jailed for defrauding the Navy, then sold a self-mythologising memoir; the series traces the war crimes of the SEAL culture he shaped through Afghanistan and Iraq.
